tool.title: Extract
tool.about: Pull the same fields out of many files into one table: a row per document, a column per field, and every value backed by the sentence and page it came from.

words.size: {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} × {fields, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

list.title: The same questions,
list.sub: Choose documents, name the fields you need, and get one table with a row per document.
list.emptyBody: Extract reads the same fields — a vendor, a date, a total — out of every document you choose and lines them up in one table, each value with the sentence and page it came from.

manage.renameBody: The name appears in the list, in exports and when you ask the chat about this table.
manage.unsharedToast: Only you can see this table now
manage.deleteBody: The table and every value in it are removed for everyone it is shared with. The documents themselves stay. This cannot be undone.

picker.title: Choose documents
picker.description: Each document becomes one row. Take a whole folder, or everything a search finds, in one click.
picker.noDocuments: There are no documents in this workspace that you can read yet. Add files in Knowledge first.
picker.picked: {count, plural, =0 {No documents selected} one {# document selected} other {# documents selected}}
picker.pickedFull: {count} selected — the most one table can hold is {max}

new.title: New table
new.sub: Each document is a row, each field a column. Every value comes with the sentence it was read from.
new.documentsEmpty: Choose the files to read: PDFs, scans, photos of receipts, Word documents. One row per file.
new.documentsDropped: {count, plural, one {# document from the link was left out: it is still being processed, or you cannot open it.} other {# documents from the link were left out: they are still being processed, or you cannot open them.}}
new.needFields: Fix the fields marked above first.

starterHints.totalAmount: The final amount due, including tax
starterHints.currency: Three-letter code, such as EUR or USD
starterHints.terminationNotice: How much notice either party must give to end the agreement

new.fieldInstructionPlaceholder: Say more when the name alone is not enough

problems.empty: Give this field a name, or remove it.
problems.duplicate: Another field already has this name.

new.replaceBody: The starter set takes the place of the fields in the editor now.
new.runNote: Reading starts at once. You can leave this tab; the table keeps filling.

grid.notRead: Not read — the run was stopped first
grid.withheld: You don't have access to this file
grid.rowFailed: This document could not be read
grid.readFromImageNote: Read from the image itself, because the file has no text. The quote is a transcription and could not be checked against text.

table.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or its owner stopped sharing it.
table.progress: {finished} of {total, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}
table.cancelBody: Documents already read keep their values. The rest are left unread.
table.failedTitle: This table could not be finished
table.cancelledNote: The run was stopped before every document was read.
table.hint: Select a value to see the sentence it came from
